_comment: Expected canary answers. The conductor compares its own determination to this AFTER answering. reportable: an alcohol-related arrest is squarely within the adverse-information tables for a cleared industry holder (with an unverified corpus the honest degraded answer is consult_fso, so both values pass only if the model states the requirement matched — but on the pure policy question the answer is yes). e_attach is false: no form was answered falsely and nothing was concealed when asked — this is a late self-report, which needs a delay explanation, not the concealment guideline.
